description: Two-panel meme using photographs of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un with military officers. In the top panel he speaks on a telephone with the added caption joking that he is calling CNN with confidential information about his own death; in the bottom panel he and the surrounding officers laugh. The meme mocks spring 2020 media reports speculating that Kim Jong-un had died.
text: Hello? Is this CNN? I have confidential information about the death of Kim Jong-Un
flags: Satirical meme; the caption is a joke, not a real quote

description: Screenshot of an anonymous 8kun post (No.9051746, 05/06/20) quoting a Liberty Nation article about Sen. Dianne Feinstein's ties to China. The attached photograph shows Feinstein with Chinese President Jiang Zemin. The post claims a 1997 Los Angeles Times article detailed her husband Richard C. Blum's growing China investments while her role on U.S.-China policy expanded, and her visits with senior Chinese officials including Jiang Zemin. An 8kun disclaimer footer is visible.
text: Anonymous 05/06/20 (Wed) 12:39:36 ID: 24534a (2) No.9051746 >>9051810 >>9051999. File (hide): 035fae34ff72047….jpg (41.07 KB, 612x347, 612:347, Zemin.jpg) (h) (u). >>9051651. >"I have a very special connection with Shanghai." https://www.libertynation.com/feinsteins-chinese-spy-facing-facts/. A 1997 Los Angeles Times article is crucial in detailing just how cozy Feinstein had become with Chinese officials at the time. The article details how Feinstein's husband Richard C. Blum began investing in China with "one project worth less than $500,000" in 1992 before suddenly planning on investing $150 million two years later. At the exact same moment that Blum's Chinese investment began to skyrocket, "Feinstein's role on U.S. policy toward China… expanded. In January 1995, she became a member of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, giving her a prominent platform for her efforts to support China's trade privileges," the Times reported. The 1997 article also reveals that Feinstein made three visits "since 1995" to meet with senior Chinese officials, including President Jiang Zemin, bringing her husband along each time.
